title: Australian Yellow Curry Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with lentils, curry, and Australian spices, perfect for a cold night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the Australian yellow curry mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, coconut milk, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
